newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIA CLOSE IN ON PLACE IN FINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIA CLOSE IN ON PLACE IN FINALS.

text.p: A goal by Adrian Ilie earned Romania a 1-0 win over Ireland on Wednesday and virtually guaranteed them a place in the World Cup finals.
Tthe Romanians' sixth successive victory left them eight points clear of Macedonia, their closest challengers in group eight.
A missed penalty four minutes into the second half cost Ireland dear. Roy Keane's spot kick, awarded for a foul on Ray Houghton by goalkeeper Bogdan Stelea, was brilliantly saved by Stelea.
Ilie struck from just outside the penalty box in the 32nd minute after a weak headed clearance by Ian Harte.
Ireland strove gallantly for an equaliser in the latter stages of the game, David Connolly squandering two opportunities from close range.
